principles.name: one pipeline
principles.clause: STRATEGY.md, Our approach: "Generation is one pipeline (grow, plan, expand, cull, draw) that every tree passes through; each family feature is a term inside a stage, never a route around it."
allowances: STRATEGY.md, Our approach: "The expansion is one algorithm with two executors, the GPU and a CPU reference that defines correct and serves consumers without one" (exception EX-50).
AGENTS.md, Mature trees are the product: the growth path is a hidden feature, kept buildable and pinned (exception EX-17).
Extracting shared code into one function both callers use, or delegating to the pipeline, removes a copy; it never adds one.

principles.name: never a fallback path
principles.clause: STRATEGY.md, Our approach: "an input the pipeline cannot represent is an explicit error, never a fallback path."
allowances: STRATEGY.md, Surface and rendering at scale: "geometry-dependent choices are allowed, and unsupported inputs remain explicit errors, never a second path."
A GPU executor that hands work to the CPU reference is one algorithm with two executors (exception EX-50).

principles.name: no switch between ways of building
principles.clause: STRATEGY.md, Our approach: "every parameter is a numeric trait defined for every tree ... so a small change in any parameter makes a small change in the tree ... A parameter may be dormant where the structure it shapes is absent, and it wakes smoothly as that structure appears; its description states where it is dormant. No parameter is a switch between ways of building, and a count steps only by one unit of the structure it counts."
allowances: Dormancy is clean: a term that contributes nothing while its structure is absent, and grows from zero as it appears.
A count that adds or removes one unit of the structure it counts is a count step, not a switch.
A backend or schedule choice (GPU or CPU executor, concurrent or serial stages) that yields the same tree is not a way of building.
Rejecting an input the pipeline cannot represent with an explicit error is validation.

principles.name: only the detail the consumer reads
principles.clause: STRATEGY.md, Our approach: "generate only the detail the consuming engine needs"
allowances: An output a named consumer reads, or one a test or measurement in the same change reads as its contract, is consumed.

principles.name: a stop must catch what its neighbours cannot
principles.clause: STRATEGY.md, Our approach: "a step that stops work must catch a defect the steps around it cannot."
allowances: AGENTS.md, Dispatch and escalation: reasoning and system design escalate to the host; a stop that hands such a step up is mandated.
Validation that rejects malformed input nothing else checks is necessary.
